item.title: US plans to cut off military aid to key Middle East ally, BBC told
item.description: Iraqi Kurdistan fears the Trump administration's plan will make the region more vulnerable to further attacks from Iran.

item.title: Footage of Tibet floods isn't being shown in China - and we know little about victims there
item.description: Some of the most dramatic footage from the deadly flash flooding is hidden from public view in China.

item.title: Russia ramps up rhetoric but wants to avoid war with Nato, Western officials say
item.description: But they say Moscow will likely continue its "hybrid activity" against Nato members, short of direct military action.

item.title: Two-year curfew lifted in Sudan's capital
item.description: The military authorities retook control of the city 18 months ago, but the conflict continues elsewhere.

item.title: Dutch court sentences man to life over Rwanda genocide
item.description: The court in The Hague convicted the 66-year-old of war crimes and the crime of genocide.
